Compare both full public observations before cast, then strict full opponent observations at pending search and after each same legal selection. Owner private views intentionally differ.
Right-hand red fourth card illegal while left multicolor fourth card initially legal; wrong owner and duplicate choices rejected atomically without observation changes.
First selection exercises owned raw/index plus independent no-selection sibling and parent disposal; wrong actor rollback compares snapshot and both frames.
Final commit moves exactly three distinct card IDs to public graveyard and shuffles; library9 versus sibling12. Public identities may then differ.
Restore original pending search, reject stale index, replay raw and compare snapshot/both frames; normalize only restored top-level observation revision.

Search choice remains private even after maximum3 selections.
Exactly3 physically distinct selected cards move only at commitment; unselected and foreign card remain in library.
Raw/index/restore preserve exact private state and shuffle RNG.
